title: scirpus americanus var. pungens
intro: Scirpus americanus var. pungens, commonly known as American bulrush, is a plant species that belongs to the sedge family. The health benefits of American bulrush include its use as a diuretic, to reduce inflammation, and to aid in the treatment of various urinary tract disorders. The therapeutic actions of American bulrush include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve spasms, and act as a mild laxative. The bioactive constituents of American bulrush include carbohydrates, fibers, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
